documents.title: Guidelines for Using Generative AI at App State
documents.summary: University-wide AI site page that encourages safe exploration of generative AI, requires use to follow existing policies and the Academic Integrity Code, and limits use of university information to reviewed tools. It asks faculty to set clear course expectations and asks everyone to verify and cite AI output.
documents.stance_why: It says "App State encourages safe exploration and use" of AI but sets no rule for coursework; "Faculty are asked to communicate clear expectations to students on generative AI use in their courses", so the course-level decision is left to instructors.

documents.title: Initial Recommendations on Generative AI Policy and Philosophy (AI syllabus guidance)
documents.summary: Provost task force recommendations giving seven principles and guidelines for instructors deciding how students may use AI, with sample syllabus statements grouped as permissive, restrictive, and mixed. It sets no single university rule and explicitly leaves choice to instructors.
documents.stance_why: It says "the continuously evolving nature of AI defies any hard and fast rules" and "Do not assume/apply a one-size fits all policy", and offers three sample categories (permissive, restrictive, mixed) rather than a rule, so the stance is delegates with tiers.
